import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_4/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, they would be listed here
    ]

    # Initialize an empty list to hold dataframes
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes into one
    all_data = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Group by 'fname' and count the number of observations per fname
    result = all_data.groupby('fname').size().reset_index(name='count_of_obs')

    # Ensure the schema matches target: fname (string), count_of_obs (int)
    result['fname'] = result['fname'].astype(str)
    result['count_of_obs'] = result['count_of_obs'].astype(int)

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_4/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
